purpose: Evidence-backed launch checklist, not an automatic security certification. Never mark verified from configuration presence alone.

gates.evidence: 20 offline security tests; candidate dependencies; see docs/RELEASE_READINESS.md
No external Python/Mongo backend is deployed; Vercel beta is a setup page only
Workspace Mongo and local media remain preserved; external durable stores are not provisioned or migrated
Extra-password middleware tested locally; external HTTPS/origin/proxy/cookie deployment is not tested
Google and preview work in existing local preview; new public origin and optional SMTP are unverified
No real-device external-origin generation/media/reel proof for the beta deployment
Preview transports remain for compatibility; review production session storage, reauthentication and CSRF end to end
Available recovered data is not the complete historical native database; never overwrite native data
Durable job ownership and end-to-end submission idempotency remain incomplete; keep one worker
Source preservation copies are not proof of database/media disaster recovery
Stripe remains TEST-only; live key/webhook/tax/refund/terms review and explicit launch authorization are pending
No complete audited account-deletion or AI-content-reporting workflow; policies and retention need owner/legal review
Adult/profanity policy conflicts; app-store billing route, package signing, developer enrollment and testing are unresolved
Exact declared PyPI pins checked via OSV; custom wheel/transitive dependencies and frontend supply chain require complete review
Request IDs/structured local audit logs implemented; centralized retention, alerts and owner escalation are not configured
Existing free test scope does not authorize paid hosting or establish commercial-production hosting eligibility
